log_dir.description: Directory to store log files for the Manila scheduler service.

log_file.description: Filename for the main scheduler log file (relative to log_dir).

debug.description: Enable debug-level logging for troubleshooting (verbose output).

transport_url.description: Message broker transport URL. Supports RabbitMQ, Redis, or fake (for testing).

scheduler_driver.description: Scheduler driver class used to select a share backend for new shares.

scheduler_default_filters.description: Ordered list of scheduler filter classes to apply when choosing a backend. Filters are AND'd together unless negated.

scheduler_weight_filters.description: List of scheduler weighter classes used to score filtered backends (higher is better).

workers.description: Number of separate worker processes to spawn for the scheduler service.

share_driver.description: Default backend share driver class (must be installed and enabled).

driver_handles_share_servers.description: Whether the driver manages share servers (true = driver handles networking, security, etc.), or false = simple driver (no share servers).

service_auth_params.description: List of service credential blocks (e.g., for authentication, locking). Each item defines a config section and its key-value pairs.

name.description: Human-readable name of the service (for documentation only).

section.description: Config file section name (e.g., keystone_authtoken, oslo_concurrency).

auth_url.description: Keystone identity endpoint URL (only for keystone_authtoken).

project_domain_name.description: Keystone project domain name (only for keystone_authtoken).

user_domain_name.description: Keystone user domain name (only for keystone_authtoken).

project_name.description: Keystone service project name (only for keystone_authtoken).

password.description: Keystone service user password (only for keystone_authtoken).

lock_path.description: Directory for file-based locking (only for oslo_concurrency).
